summary: Iteration 2 frontend-only re-test (KFZ-Meisterwerkstatt Isaak landing). All 3 new features verified on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844): (1) hero-video element with src ending /hero-reifen.mp4 + poster fallback present (server returns 206 bytes range, content-type video/mp4); (2) two live open-status pills render (one in hero Phase A, one in contact Öffnungszeiten card) with data-open attribute and label 'Jetzt geöffnet · bis 18:30 Uhr'; (3) whatsapp-fab visible only on desktop, mobile-call-bar visible only on mobile with grid-cols-3 (call, whatsapp, route), and contact-whatsapp-button present — all WhatsApp links point to wa.me/491639755353 with target=_blank rel=noopener noreferrer. Hero CTAs and all sections (contact, services, location, opening-hours-list, footer, main-nav) regress-pass. 0 page errors, 0 console errors. Only carryover: 2 framer-motion warnings about non-static position container (non-blocking, same as iteration 1).

issues: Carryover from iter 1: 2 framer-motion console warnings 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position...'. Non-blocking. The wrapperRef div has no explicit position class — adding `relative` would silence it.

action_items: (Optional, non-blocking) Add `relative` class to the wrapperRef div in /app/frontend/src/components/HeroScroll.jsx (line 80) to eliminate framer-motion useScroll warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: HERO_VIDEO = `${process.env.PUBLIC_URL || ''}/hero-reifen.mp4` correctly resolves to /hero-reifen.mp4 and is served by the dev server with 206 partial-content + content-type video/mp4 (verified). Headless Chromium falls back to poster image which is expected behavior — real browsers will play the H.264 mp4.
WhatsApp links correctly use international format wa.me/491639755353 (no leading +) and include a pre-encoded German message, target=_blank + rel=noopener noreferrer everywhere.
OpenStatus uses Europe/Berlin time via toLocaleString — correct cross-timezone behavior. Verified to render 'Jetzt geöffnet · bis 18:30 Uhr' with data-open='true' at test time (Mon afternoon Berlin).
MobileCallBar uses grid-cols-3 and lg:hidden; WhatsAppFab uses lg:flex + hidden — responsive visibility is correctly inverted between the two components.
